_meta.purpose: Commitment-register markers for the deterministic (no-LLM) hedge/booster grader. Two poles reported SEPARATELY, never one collapsed scalar. Read DELTAS across conditions/sigils, never absolutes.
_meta.category_scheme: mirrors findings/scout-register-lexicons.md (the QA-rig scout) — Hyland (2005) Appendix A core + Wikipedia Manual-of-Style Words-to-Watch + CoNLL-2010/BioScope cue categories + LIWC tentat/certain samples + a composed conversational patch.
_meta.discipline: multi-word phrases match BEFORE single tokens; word-boundary, case-insensitive; POS-ambiguous KILLERS excluded from the headline; clause-initial-only discourse boosters counted only at clause start (handled by register.py, not this file).
_meta.honest_gaps: the full LIWC dictionaries are proprietary (~5 sample words each carried); the full BioScope per-token list is gated; composed conversational phrases are register-fit patches grounded in the literature, NOT pulled verbatim from one open list.

provenance.hyland_2005_appendix_a: Hyland, K. (2005) Metadiscourse — the field-standard hedge/booster division (epistemic modals/adverbs/adjectives/verbs vs adverbials/adjectivals/factive verbs).
provenance.wikipedia_words_to_watch: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Manual_of_Style/Words_to_watch — peacock (booster), weasel/unsupported-attribution (hedge), expressions-of-doubt (hedge), editorializing (mixed). Closer genre-fit to short casual model answers than Hyland.
provenance.conll_2010_bioscope: Vincze et al. 2008 (BioScope); CoNLL-2010 shared task — the most rigorously human-annotated open hedge-cue source; categories + frequent cues open, full per-token corpus gated.
provenance.liwc_tentat_certain: LIWC2007 manual — tentat (155w) / certain (83w); dictionaries proprietary, only sample words carried.
provenance.composed_conversational: register-fit patch for the casual short-answer genre Hyland's academic list misses (I think / maybe / pretty sure / definitely). verified:false — grounded in the literature, not one citable open list.

ambiguous.note: handle-with-care; register.py owns the runtime handling. Listed here for transparency.
